items.content_text:
About Etched
Etched is building hardware for frontier intelligence. We co-design chips, racks, software, and manufacturing to deliver best-in-class throughput and latency across both prefill and decode workloads. Our first products are heavily focused on inference. Backed by hundreds of millions from top-tier investors and staffed by leading engineers, Etched is redefining the infrastructure layer for the fastest growing industry in history.
Job Summary
Our Signal Integrity and Power Integrity (SI/PI) interns will work on both hands-on high-speed design and the development of SI/PI simulation and validation infrastructure for boards that will support bleeding edge systems and silicon.
Our Platform Team is building the full-stack system that supports Etched Silicon from PCB to Rack. We are seeking interns to work across all aspects of mechanical and electrical engineering to design the future of high power ASIC systems. We are looking for Summer '27 interns.
You may be a good fit if you have
- Progress towards a Bachelor's or Master's in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field
- Experience building real boards, running lab measurements, or other hands-on hardware work.
- Knowledge of high-speed interconnects, transmission line theory, power delivery, and SI/PI simulation or measurement.
We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every qualification.
Program details
- 12-week paid internship
- Generous housing support for those relocating
- Daily lunch and dinner in our office
- Based at our office in San Jose, CA
- Direct mentorship from industry leaders and world-class engineers
- Opportunity to work on one of the most important problems of our time
For any questions, contact internships@etched.com

items.title: Harness Design Co-Op
items.content_text:
About the role
>
Muon is seeking a part-time Co-Op Harness Designer to join our electrical engineering team, intended for students in the surrounding area. Working under the mentorship of current harness designers, you will specify connectors, crimps, wire types, and harness build instructions. You will also need to be flexible and incorporate feedback from the AIT team to improve designs for spacecraft integration and testing. This role involves working simultaneously across multiple missions and projects while partnering with various engineers, designers, and technicians.
>
This is a hybrid role that requires regular on-site collaboration with our engineering team.
>
Responsibilities
>
Create harness drawings, BOMs and maintain system diagrams
>
Specify connector and crimp part numbers in accordance with system design
>
Gather feedback from AIT, EE and Mechanical for initial designs and improvements
>
Work with electrical engineering to ensure compliance with signal integrity, grounding, and shielding requirements
>
Release documentation into PLM with ECO/DCO
>
Answer vendor questions on harness builds and feedback quality issues
>
As required assist in house technicians with harness builds and questions
>
Qualifications
>
Attention to detail, strong reading comprehension and a desire for ownership
>
Some experience creating harness drawings or electrical schematics in any software (school projects, clubs, or personal builds count)
>
Basic familiarity with, or willingness to learn, how harnesses are built from scratch.
>
Excited to work in a fast-paced environment with new challenges each week
>

While not a daily requirement, hands-on intuition helps inform strip lengths, crimper settings, splicing techniques, heatshrink selection, and torque values.

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected OperationsTM Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. Overview:
>
Astera Labs Inc. is seeking an experienced and self-driven Hardware Lab Engineer to join our dynamic team in developing world class connectivity products for AI infrastructure.
>
Job Description
>
This is an entry-level role in Post-Si Electrical Validation working with low-level electrical signals in the lab to validate the performance of high-speed ASICs on PCIe and DDR interfaces. Our team works closely with firmware, system validation, quality, and product engineers to support silicon bring-up, characterization, and debug activities through hands-on lab execution. The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of analog and digital circuits, signal integrity, python automation, and the ability to work on complex, open-ended tasks with minimal oversight.
>
Key Responsibilities
>
Setup and maintain test environments for silicon validation and characterization. Configure and update hardware, software, firmware, and applications.
>
Conduct hands-on testing of silicon devices including PCIe Gen5/6/7, CXL, DDR, and other high-speed interfaces
>
Use high-speed oscilloscopes and Bit-Error-Rate-Testers (BERTs) to validate Tx and Rx compliance to spec.
>
Manage logistics and communications with external vendors
>
Develop, document, and maintain lab procedures
>
Required Qualifications
>
Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field
>
0-2 years of hands-on experience in lab environments supporting silicon validation or hardware development
>
Knowledge of analog/mixed-signal circuit testing and debugging techniques
>
Strong programming skills in Python for test automation
>
Familiarity with Linux operating systems and command-line tools
>
Strong written and verbal communication skills and ability to track multiple details in parallel.
>
Preferred Qualifications
>
Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field

🎨 OpusClip https://www.opus.pro is the world's No.1 AI video agent, built for authenticity on social media.
We envision a world where everyone can authentically share their story through video, with no expertise needed. Within just 18 months of our launch, over 20 million creators and businesses have used OpusClip to enhance their social presence.
We have raised $50 million in total funding and are fortunate to have some of the most supportive investors, including SoftBank Vision Fund, DCM Ventures, Millennium New Horizons, Fellows Fund, AI Grant, Jason Lemkin (SaaStr), Samsung Next, GTMfund, Alumni Ventures, and many more.

Headquartered in Mountain View, we are a team of 100 passionate and experienced AI enthusiasts and video experts, driven by our core values:
- Be a Champion Team
- Prioritize Ruthlessly
- Ship fast, Quality Follows
- Obsess over customers
Be a part of this exciting journey with us!

We're looking for an AI Research Intern to join our AI team and explore cutting-edge research across multimodal AI, LLMs, computer vision, speech, and agent systems.
You'll work across OpusClip, AgentOpus, and our next-generation AI products, collaborating closely with AI researchers and engineers to investigate emerging technologies, build research prototypes, and ship features used by millions of creators worldwide.
